name: Sansei Technologies, Inc.
summary: Sansei Technologies, Inc. plans, designs, manufactures, installs, repairs, and maintains amusement rides, stage equipment, elevators, and other designed equipment in Japan, North America, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. Its amusement rides include dark rides, flume and family rides, omnimover, observation towers, water rides, tea cup rides, sky journey rides, train rides, roller coasters, and thrill rides. The company also provides stage equipment, such as floor mechanisms comprising elevators for stage (Seri), sliding stage system, orchestra, and raked and revolving stage systems.
